architecture.target: Encrypted Stellar-ledger records and manifests durable across devices; local storage as optional encrypted cache

principles.goal: One vault engine, one shared UI/UX, multiple platform hosts; no independent platform forks of vault semantics.
principles.business_logic: Keep mnemonic derivation, vault encryption/decryption, recovery, record/folder/file protocols and ledger semantics in StellarVault.Core or reusable shared services rather than duplicating per host.
principles.ui_reference: PWA is the design and interaction baseline. Android, iOS, Windows and macOS use StellarVault.UI Razor components, shared styling, navigation, forms, and approval flows.
principles.mobile_equivalence: MAUI Android and iOS should provide the same vault features and recognizable responsive UI/UX as mobile PWA; platform adaptations only when necessary for native usability or security.
principles.platform_boundaries: PWA and MAUI hosts provide browser/native signing, secure storage, file picker/export, lifecycle and platform permissions through adapters.
principles.source_of_truth: Confirmed encrypted on-chain records/manifests are recoverable from Stellar; device cache must not be required for cross-device restoration and no silent local fallback when a ledger write fails.
principles.mnemonic_recovery: On clean device derive account keys from BIP-39 mnemonic using supported derivation scheme and network, discover account/HD registry and encrypted entries, reconstruct vault; request encryption passphrase/recovery key when required by format.
principles.security: Do not assume mnemonic alone decrypts a separately passphrase-encrypted data key; document correct required secrets. Do not claim verified until clean-device Testnet evidence.
principles.testing: Cross-platform parity requires same Core test vectors, functional flow tests for PWA/mobile, and Testnet recovery without original IndexedDB.
principles.maintenance: Favor changes to shared Core and UI; host-only differences should be explicit, isolated and tested.
